About FoodShare

Good food finds someone who needs it — not a bin.

FoodShare is a simple handoff platform that connects donors with surplus food to nearby NGOs who can collect and distribute it while it's still good. No middlemen, no waste, no wasted time.

Why we started

Every day, good food goes to waste right next to people who need it

Restaurants over-prep, hotels over-cater, and events always have leftovers. Meanwhile, NGOs spend hours on the phone trying to track down that same surplus before it spoils. The two sides rarely find each other in time.

FoodShare closes that gap with a live board: donors post what's left, NGOs claim it in one click, and the food moves before the freshness window closes.

What we believe
  • Surplus food is a logistics problem, not a generosity problem.
  • The faster a handoff happens, the more of it stays edible.
  • Donors and NGOs both deserve a record of the good they've done.
What drives us

Three things we optimise for

Everything on the platform — from the freshness stamp to the one-click accept — serves one of these.

Speed

Every minute a donation sits unclaimed is a minute closer to the bin. The whole flow is built to shrink that window.

Trust

Verified NGO partners, clear status tracking, and a full history of every donation from post to pickup.

Simplicity

Posting a donation takes under a minute. Claiming one takes one click. No paperwork in between.

Since we started

Surplus food, rescued fast

Good food shouldn't end up in the bin.

FoodShare connects restaurants, hotels, event kitchens and households with nearby NGOs who can collect surplus food while it's still good — turning what's left over into a meal that matters.

I have food to give I collect for a cause
Live surplus board

Food available for pickup right now

Browse as an NGO →
The three-step handoff

From extra plates to someone's plate

A donation moves through exactly three states — nothing gets lost in between.

01 · Donor

Post the surplus

Log what's left — food type, quantity, and a best-before time — in under a minute.

02 · NGO

Accept the pickup

Nearby NGOs see it land on their board and claim it before the freshness window closes.

03 · Confirmed

Confirm it's delivered

Once collected, the NGO marks it received — closing the loop and logging the impact.

For donors

Restaurants, hotels, supermarkets, event organisers and households with food to spare.

  • Post a donation in under a minute
  • Track status from posted to collected
  • Cancel or edit anytime before pickup
Sign up as a donor

For NGOs

Registered organisations collecting and distributing food to people who need it.

  • See every available donation in one board
  • Accept with one click before it expires
  • Keep a record of everything you've rescued
